phrase.text: Conversions change a value's type explicitly: from number to text, from text to number, or from real to text with a fixed number of decimals.

blocks.alt: Back and forth between text and number
blocks.description: At the top, the text "42" becomes a number with toInteger and comes back with toText. Below, the text "doce" cannot be converted and toInteger fails.

caption.text: Conversions go back and forth between text and numbers. If the text is not a number, the conversion fails instead of making up a zero.
